criteria_matrix.title: Verify canonical Wave 5 SHA256 hash (527d673ac4ba0b323b4a6d58dc7d66318bad90c442e20d8ba039b57e1d8e9993) is reproducible and correction documented
criteria_matrix.evidence: Deterministic recomputation across all 20 Wave 5 files yields combined hash 527d673ac4ba0b323b4a6d58dc7d66318bad90c442e20d8ba039b57e1d8e9993. Report correction documented with status PASS_WITH_REPORT_CORRECTION in WAVE_5_VERIFICATION.md and WAVE_5_CANONICAL_MANIFEST.json.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify all 120 synthetic fixtures are exercised in raw pytest output
criteria_matrix.evidence: All 120 synthetic cases in tests/fixtures/integration_design/integration_cases.jsonl are loaded and asserted across 6 operating modes (20 cases/mode) in tests/test_controlled_integration_acceptance.py.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify LEGACY_ONLY is the true default operating mode
criteria_matrix.evidence: FeatureFlagManager defaults to LEGACY_ONLY mode, setting all sub-flags to False except audit_logging_enabled=True. Confirmed in tests/test_controlled_integration_flags.py.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify SHADOW_COMPARE never alters primary legacy output
criteria_matrix.evidence: Orchestrator in SHADOW_COMPARE mode returns legacy baseline response as primary return value. Secondary GraphRAG processing is executed in an isolated inner try-except block.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify unknown flags and invalid modes fail closed
criteria_matrix.evidence: FeatureFlagManager raises FeatureFlagError (ERR_FF_03/ERR_07) on unknown modes/flags; Orchestrator routes caught exceptions to _fail_closed_fallback() with FALLBACK_TRIGGERED verdict.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify emergency disable overrides all modes and flags
criteria_matrix.evidence: is_emergency_disabled() checks CLINICAL_AI_EMERGENCY_DISABLE env var, EMERGENCY_DISABLED operating mode, and data/EMERGENCY_DISABLE.sentinel file, immediately forcing all sub-flags False.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify Gate D cannot consume unreviewed novelty
criteria_matrix.evidence: BoundaryAdapter uses EvidenceEligibilityChecker to block DISCOVERY_ONLY and PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW candidates. Forced leaks raise UnreviewedNoveltyLeakError, triggering fallback.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify 0 protected production imports, 0 Neo4j calls, 0 graph writes, 0 network calls, 0 LLM calls, 0 raw narrative storage
criteria_matrix.evidence: AST analysis verifies 0 forbidden imports. Socket/urllib monkeypatches confirm 0 network/Neo4j/LLM calls. SecurityPolicy denies knowledge_graph_write and raw narrative storage.

criteria_matrix.title: Verify audit trails are cryptographic SHA-256 chained and telemetry identifiers are redacted
criteria_matrix.evidence: AuditLogger embeds _seq, _prev_hash, _hash and verifies full chain integrity. TelemetryCollector hashes user IDs with salted SHA-256 and redacts PII string patterns.

criteria_matrix.evidence: Raw pytest output file tests/WAVE_6_FINAL_PYTEST_OUTPUT.txt confirms 169 passed tests across 9 test modules with 0 failures and exit code 0.
